summary: Shoshone County tower in the St. Joe National Forest: camp 1929, L-4 tower 1935, destroyed 1952. No source describes what remains at the site.

facts.design: L-4 tower atop the northernmost end of the ridge
facts.status_note: Tower destroyed in 1952; no source describes what remains

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site a hike-in. The sources read give no route.

notes_for_editor: The two web listings give the same years and may share a source. Staffing rests on one Known Staff entry (Boyd Hanna, 1930) that cites a book; the book itself was not read. No route, remains or access rule was found, so the story is short. The record's coordinates are not contradicted by these sources.
